scenarios.title: A｜寻找
scenarios.setting: 玩家在外面准备付款时，突然发现钱包不在身上。

turns.text: Sorry, I can’t find my wallet. Did I leave it here by any chance?

turns.prompt: 对方在确认位置或去向，你会怎样说清楚地点？

choices.text: I was sitting at the table near the entrance.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was sitting at the table near the entrance.
feedback.explanation: “entrance”指入口，区别于出口。

choices.text: I paid here about an hour ago, so I may have left it at the counter.

feedback.naturalExpression: I paid here about an hour ago, so I may have left it at the counter.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

choices.text: Has anyone turned in a black wallet?

feedback.naturalExpression: Has anyone turned in a black wallet?
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: Could you check your lost and found for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check your lost and found for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Did someone give you my lost wallet?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I was sitting at the table near the entrance.
feedback.explanation: 捡到钱包交给工作人员常说“turn it in”；“give you”没明确这是失物上交。

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s a small black leather wallet.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a small black leather wallet.
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: It has several bank cards and some cash inside.

feedback.naturalExpression: It has several bank cards and some cash inside.
feedback.explanation: “cash”指现金，是说明付款方式的直接用词。

choices.text: My driver’s license is inside, so my name should be on it.

feedback.naturalExpression: My driver’s license is inside, so my name should be on it.
feedback.explanation: “driver’s license”是驾驶执照，说明失物中的证件有助于辨认身份。

turns.text: I’m sorry. We haven’t had any wallets turned in today.

turns.prompt: 你想和对方确认继续寻找物品的办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Could you contact me if someone finds it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Could you contact me if someone finds it?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Thanks for checking. I’ll retrace my steps.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for checking. I’ll retrace my steps.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: All right. I should probably contact my bank as well.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. I should probably contact my bank as well.
feedback.explanation: “as well”表示也、还，常用于在已有事项上补充另一项需求。

scenarios.title: B｜联系银行
scenarios.setting: 在“钱包 / 银行卡遗失”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“联系银行”。

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve lost my wallet, and my bank card was inside.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve lost my wallet, and my bank card was inside.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: I’d like to freeze my card because I can’t find it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to freeze my card because I can’t find it.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: My card may have been stolen. Could you block it for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: My card may have been stolen. Could you block it for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I need to make sure nobody can use my card.

feedback.naturalExpression: I need to make sure nobody can use my card.
feedback.explanation: “make sure”表示核实、确认，能说明重复提问是为避免理解出错。

choices.text: I want to stop my bank card.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve lost my wallet, and my bank card was inside.
feedback.explanation: 临时停用银行卡常说“freeze / block my card”，比“stop”明确。

turns.text: Have you noticed any transactions you don’t recognize?

turns.prompt: 关于「钱包」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: No, not so far.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, not so far.
feedback.explanation: “so far”表示到目前为止，适合评价一段仍在进行的经历。

choices.text: Yes. There’s a payment I don’t recognize.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. There’s a payment I don’t recognize.
feedback.explanation: “don’t recognize”表示认不出或没有印象，适合先核查陌生记录，而不急于断言有错。

choices.text: I haven’t checked yet. Could you help me review the recent transactions?

feedback.naturalExpression: I haven’t checked yet. Could you help me review the recent transactions?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: I’ll freeze the card for now.

turns.prompt: 你想确认冻结银行卡后的使用和恢复规则，会怎么说？

choices.text: Can I unfreeze it if I find my wallet?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I unfreeze it if I find my wallet?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Will this stop contactless payments as well?

feedback.naturalExpression: Will this stop contactless payments as well?
feedback.explanation: “contactless”指非接触式支付，也就是通过感应完成付款。

choices.text: Can I still use my account through the banking app?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I still use my account through the banking app?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: How can I get a replacement card?

feedback.naturalExpression: How can I get a replacement card?
feedback.explanation: “a replacement”指替换品，区别于直接退款或继续等待维修。

scenarios.title: C｜解决临时付款问题
scenarios.setting: 银行卡被冻结，但玩家还在旅行，需要支付酒店等费用。

turns.text: How would you like to pay?

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: I’ve lost my wallet. Would it be possible to pay another way?

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve lost my wallet. Would it be possible to pay another way?
feedback.explanation: 先问是否有可能安排，适合需要对方查看余位或规则的请求，语气比直接要求更柔和。

choices.text: My physical card is missing, but I still have access to my mobile wallet.

feedback.naturalExpression: My physical card is missing, but I still have access to my mobile wallet.
feedback.explanation: “is missing”表示应有的东西缺失，便于核对订单或随身物品。

choices.text: Do you accept mobile payments?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you accept mobile payments?
feedback.explanation: “mobile payments”指可用的付款方式，先确认是否接受再支付更顺畅。

choices.text: Could someone else pay for the room on my behalf?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could someone else pay for the room on my behalf?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: I don’t have money because I lost my wallet.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’ve lost my wallet. Would it be possible to pay another way?
feedback.explanation: 丢钱包不一定代表完全没钱；若是暂时无法付款，说明“can’t access my money”更准确。

turns.prompt: 你想确认或选择付款方式，会怎么说？

choices.text: Great. Can I pay with my phone, then?

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Can I pay with my phone, then?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Perfect. Let me see if my card still works through my mobile wallet.

feedback.naturalExpression: Perfect. Let me see if my card still works through my mobile wallet.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: If that doesn’t work, what other payment methods do you accept?

feedback.naturalExpression: If that doesn’t work, what other payment methods do you accept?
feedback.explanation: “payment methods”指可用的付款方式，先确认是否接受再支付更顺畅。

turns.text: You can try the mobile payment first.

turns.prompt: 你想回应刚才的提议，确认接受或愿意配合，会怎么说？

choices.text: Okay. Let me try.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Let me try.
feedback.explanation: “Let me …”提出由自己来做下一步，能明确谁来采取行动。

choices.text: Great. Hopefully this works.

feedback.naturalExpression: Great. Hopefully this works.
feedback.explanation: “hopefully”表达希望事情朝某个方向发展，不等于保证结果。
